onChange.script:
self.custom.tab = 'home'
	want = self.params.tab
	if want in ('home', 'config', 'diagnostics', 'alarms', 'interlocks', 'info'):
		self.custom.tab = want
	self.custom.message = ''
	self.custom.pending = {'active': False, 'device': '', 'path': '', 'member': '', 'value': 0, 'text': ''}
	self.custom.refused = False

self.custom.tab = 'home'
	want = currentValue.value
	if want in ('home', 'config', 'diagnostics', 'alarms', 'interlocks', 'info'):
		self.custom.tab = want

config.script:
p = self.view.custom.pending
	msg = cadre.hmi.command(self.session, p.path, self.view.params.deviceId, p.member, p.value)
	self.view.custom.pending = {'active': False, 'device': '', 'path': '', 'member': '', 'value': 0, 'text': ''}
	self.view.custom.message = msg

config.expression: if({view.custom.refused}, 'Start refused: ', if({view.custom.ilk.interlocked}, 'Interlocked: ', 'Start not permitted: ')) + if({view.custom.ilk.unsatisfied} > 0, toStr({view.custom.ilk.unsatisfied}) + ' condition' + if({view.custom.ilk.unsatisfied} = 1, '', 's') + ' not met', 'reset required')

config.script: self.view.custom.pending = {'active': True, 'device': self.view.params.deviceId, 'path': 'W18', 'member': 'cmdInService', 'value': True, 'text': self.props.text + ': ' + self.session.custom.selectedTitle + '?'}

self.view.custom.pending = {'active': True, 'device': self.view.params.deviceId, 'path': 'W18', 'member': 'cmdOutOfService', 'value': True, 'text': self.props.text + ': ' + self.session.custom.selectedTitle + '?'}

self.view.custom.pending = {'active': True, 'device': self.view.params.deviceId, 'path': 'W18', 'member': 'cmdEnable', 'value': True, 'text': self.props.text + ': ' + self.session.custom.selectedTitle + '?'}

self.view.custom.pending = {'active': True, 'device': self.view.params.deviceId, 'path': 'W18', 'member': 'cmdDisable', 'value': True, 'text': self.props.text + ': ' + self.session.custom.selectedTitle + '?'}

self.view.custom.pending = {'active': True, 'device': self.view.params.deviceId, 'path': 'W18', 'member': 'trigger', 'value': True, 'text': self.props.text + ': ' + self.session.custom.selectedTitle + '?'}

transforms.code:
parts = (value or '').split('|')
	return cadre.hmi.config_rows(self.session, parts[0], len(parts) > 1 and parts[1] == '1')

config.script: self.view.custom.pending = {'active': True, 'device': self.view.params.deviceId, 'path': 'W17', 'member': 'mnt/errorMask', 'value': True, 'text': self.props.text + ': ' + self.session.custom.selectedTitle + '?'}

self.view.custom.pending = {'active': True, 'device': self.view.params.deviceId, 'path': 'W17', 'member': 'mnt/errorMask', 'value': False, 'text': self.props.text + ': ' + self.session.custom.selectedTitle + '?'}

self.view.custom.pending = {'active': True, 'device': self.view.params.deviceId, 'path': 'W11', 'member': 'ilk/resetAt', 'value': True, 'text': self.props.text + ': ' + self.session.custom.selectedTitle + '?'}
